comments.comment: Have to say Russell's out of hand kicking was superb. Also i do think if this was the young Russell he would of thrown the long pass at 5:24 and the lions would have lost.  Edit:  And I thought the wallabies dive at the end was disgraceful that kind of play has no place in rugby.  Further edit:  And kinghorn was great off the bench with 2 critical line breaks to get the lions into winning territory. I'm pleased for keenan, but if Andy mixes up the team next week he kinghorn deserves to start. And I promise he will make a mockery of the aussies wide defense and will be a serious ariel threat. And too those who seem to think he's another average player I hope you watch some toulouse (probably the best club in the world) highlights, and scotland six nations highlights, then you'll understand the man. And finally Curry the aptly named "test match animal" was amazing today and showed he clearly was the right man for shirt.
